team_template.name: Cyber Colloquium Basic Team
team_template.description: Default multi-role research team that preserves the current Cyber Colloquium workflow.

roles.label: Lead
roles.specialty_hint: Task decomposition, delegation, and quality control

roles.label: Reviewer
roles.specialty_hint: Literature review, related-work mapping, and source digestion

roles.label: Notetaker
roles.specialty_hint: Structured logging, synthesis, and final document writing

workflow_template.name: Research Discussion Review Workflow
workflow_template.description: Default configurable research workflow: ingest sources, discuss, review, update structured state, then generate notes and report.

stages.label: Discover arXiv Literature
stages.description: Optionally search arXiv from the user request, download selected papers, and register metadata before ingesting sources.

stages.label: Ingest Source Material
stages.description: Prepare user question, source material, PDF reader context, and optional literature review input.

stages.label: Run Team Discussion
stages.description: Run lead delegation, host coordination, and primary analyst execution.

stages.label: Expand Literature Search
stages.description: Let the lead or experts propose targeted arXiv queries from discussion gaps, then refresh the evidence pool before reviewer pass.

stages.label: Run Reviewer Pass
stages.description: Run reviewer cross-checks for each workpackage when reviewer participation is enabled.

stages.label: Update Structured State
stages.description: Run state consolidation, checkpoints, and unresolved-issue follow-ups.

stages.label: Run Experiment Cycle
stages.description: Generate executable experiment scaffolds, run authorized local tests, and feed outcomes back into the structured state.

stages.label: Generate Meeting Notes
stages.description: Generate meeting notes from the structured intermediate state.

stages.label: Generate Research Report
stages.description: Generate the final research report from the structured intermediate state.

stages.label: Compile LaTeX Artifacts
stages.description: Optionally build BibTeX and LaTeX export artifacts and compile them with local Tectonic when authorized.
